# bitHuman

bitHuman turns one portrait image into a talking avatar you can render locally,
in a browser, on a phone, or through a hosted API. Two second-generation model
families ship today, and they are different engines, not tiers of one.

- `essence-2` — photorealistic people. Renders 1920x1080, delivers at 25 fps.
  This is the default.
- `expression-2` — stylised and character avatars. Renders 416x720 at 20 fps.

The two earlier families, `essence-1` and `expression-1`, are still served but
are not where new work should start.

## Facts an agent following these docs most often gets wrong

- The API values are exactly `essence-2`, `expression-2`, `essence-1`,
  `expression-1`. In prose the docs write them "Essence 2" / "Expression 2".
- `bithuman pull <slug>` is FREE and needs no account. `bithuman render` and
  `bithuman run` REQUIRE `bithuman login`. The pull/render split is the single
  most important fact about the CLI.
- Creating an agent costs credits: 250 (Essence 1 / Expression 1), 500
  (Essence 2), 2000 (Expression 2). The free tier is 99 credits a month, so it
  does not cover any creation.
- `pip install` needs a virtualenv first on stock Debian/Ubuntu, or it fails
  with `error: externally-managed-environment`.
- Avatar downloads are large — roughly 118-190 MB each. Expect the wait.
- Apple on-device needs iPhone 16 Pro+ / iPad Pro M4+ / Mac M3+ on OS 26, plus
  two Apple entitlements that take 1-3 business days to be granted.

## Start here

- [Quickstart](https://docs.bithuman.ai/start): the two fastest paths — an
  embeddable viewer, and the command-line tool.
- [Models](https://docs.bithuman.ai/concepts/models-v2): what each family is
  for, and the naming and migration rules.
- [Pricing and credits](https://docs.bithuman.ai/guides/pricing): what creation
  and rendering cost, and what the free tier covers.

## Build on a platform

- [Python SDK](https://docs.bithuman.ai/sdk/python): `pip install bithuman` —
  open an avatar, push audio, take RGB frames.
- [Command line](https://docs.bithuman.ai/sdk/cli): pull, render and run
  avatars locally; [reference](https://docs.bithuman.ai/sdk/cli/reference).
- [Web](https://docs.bithuman.ai/sdk/web): in-browser rendering; WebGPU is the
  intended path.
- [Android](https://docs.bithuman.ai/sdk/android): Maven Central
  `ai.bithuman:essence2-android` and `ai.bithuman:expression2-android`;
  [API reference](https://docs.bithuman.ai/sdk/android-api).
- [iOS, iPadOS and macOS](https://docs.bithuman.ai/sdk/ios): one SwiftPM
  package vends `Essence2` and `Expression2` for all three.
- [LiveKit](https://docs.bithuman.ai/sdk/livekit): drive an avatar as a LiveKit
  agent.
- [REST API](https://docs.bithuman.ai/api/quickstart): create and render
  without installing anything.
